entries.05977daa8ec4949b: Corporate Clients Engaged in SNS Marketing
entries.05a182b1dd0506cf: A field that supports SNS operations on platforms such as Facebook, X, Instagram, TikTok and LINE Official, as well as companies' use of social media from strategy through operation.
entries.09b4cefe400baa38: A field that provides digital content, including stock photo services. Consolidated subsidiary CREAVE Co., Ltd. operates a digital material sales site and is responsible for product photography and SNS marketing.
entries.25739bf7e30ee77d: A business that provides end-to-end support, from strategic planning to operation, for marketing related to companies' SNS and communities. It mainly provides planning, development and operation of SNS, blogs, social media utilization support, WEB marketing support and digital content services to corporate clients. Its head office is in Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,377 million.
entries.29083548cc28168f: A business providing investment and development support to companies inside and outside the group and developing new businesses. In addition to hands-on support for investees, it undertakes entrepreneurship education and acceleration programs from external organizations such as local governments, plans and operates sharing services, and provides DAO construction support, among other activities. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,120 million.
